t: Beauty and the Beast: Sticks and Stones
d: A deaf girl, who used to live below, falls in with a street gang that threatens to put an end to her first serious love affair.

t: Beauty and the Beast: A Fair and Perfect Knight
d: Catherine befriends a boy from the world below who leaves the tunnels to go college.
A young man gets lost in the tunnel world and he is found by the inhabitants. They're uncertain if they should let him go because they're not sure if he can be trusted to keep their secret.
Vincent's "brother" Devin returns with Charles, a hideously deformed man seeking sanctuary.

t: Beauty and the Beast: A Gentle Rain
d: Kanin, a resident of the Underworld, goes into a store on the surface and is recognized by a woman as the man who killed her son, years ago.

t: Beauty and the Beast: The Outsiders"
d: When intruders penetrates their tunnel world, father decides to welcome them with gifts, but instead of gratitude, they are met with greed and violence. Things escalate to the point that tunnel dwellers have no other choice but to leave.
After her father dies, Catherine thinks about living the rest of her life in the world below.
Vincent's childhood sweetheart returns to the tunnels, and Vincent reveals a painful memory of her to Catherine.

t: Beauty and the Beast: When the Blue Bird Sings
d: Catherine meets a persistent artist, who follows and spies on her. But this artist isn't all what he seems to be.

t: Beauty and the Beast: The Watcher
d: On Vincent and Catherine's two year anniversary, Catherine receives a phone message indicating that someone is watching them.

t: Beauty and the Beast: A Distant Shore
d: Catherine heads out to L.A California, to find a witness for an investigation.
Catherine is put in charge of a murder case in court, and to bring justice to a five year old murdered son.

t: Beauty and the Beast: A Kingdom by the Sea
d: Catherine is blocked out of an investigation involving a murder attempt by the C.I.A. But there are more shocks yet to come, and a familiar face returns.

t: Beauty and the Beast: The Hollow Men
d: Vincent witnesses their latest murder and is unable to stop them.

t: Beauty and the Beast: What Rough Beast
d: Catherine is attacked in the park by two men disguised as policemen.

t: Beauty and the Beast: Ceremony of Innocence
d: Following the death of investigative reporter, Bernie Spirko, Elliot Burch and Catherine set out to find the man who hired and killed Spirko.

t: Beauty and the Beast: The Rest Is Silence…
d: Following the ordeal with Paracelcus, Vincent moves forward toward a stress-aggravated mental collapse. Vincent continues to come to terms with the beast in himself and finds himself losing control of his thoughts.
